description: This file defines the 'Query' class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, providing static methods for parsing query strings into arrays and building query strings from arrays.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: A utility class for parsing and building URL query strings.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a query string into an associative array, handling multiple values for the same key.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds a query string from an array of key-value pairs, with optional encoding.
